name: neo-angband-mod-anybandui
description: AnybandUI for Neo Angband: a mouse-first desktop interface ported from Wurli Monkhaven's AnybandUI frontend
author: Wurli Monkhaven and neostryder (RPGM Tools)
//private: Not published to npm. A mod is distributed as a FOLDER the game fetches:
manifest.json plus plugin.js, at a tag. npm is not in that path, and publishing
would create a second way to get this mod that nothing checks.
//dependencies: The engine is a devDependency, never a dependency. plugin.js receives it as
ctx.core at load time; a runtime dependency would put a second copy of the
engine's module state inside the mod, which the builder refuses. It is here for
types, so a field this mod reads that moves in the engine fails typecheck here.
The mod SDK is here for tools/build.mjs, which runs its plugin builder to produce

scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check
